title: Midjourney Pricing in 2026: Is It Worth the Cost?

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic plan costs $10 per month on monthly billing.
facts.quote: | Basic | $10 | $8 | 3.3 hrs (~200 images) | No | No | 3 |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Standard plan costs $30 per month on monthly billing.
facts.quote: | Standard | $30 | $24 | 15 hrs (~900 images) | Unlimited | No | 3 |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Pro plan costs $60 per month on monthly billing.
facts.quote: | Pro | $60 | $48 | 30 hrs (~1,800 images) | Unlimited | Yes | 12 |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Mega plan costs $120 per month on monthly billing.
facts.quote: | Mega | $120 | $96 | 60 hrs (~3,600 images) | Unlimited | Yes | 12 |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic plan includes 3.3 fast GPU hours per month, roughly 200 images.
facts.quote: Basic | $10 | $8 | 3.3 hrs (~200 images)

facts.fact: Midjourney's Standard plan includes 15 fast GPU hours per month, roughly 900 images.
facts.quote: Standard | $30 | $24 | 15 hrs (~900 images)

facts.fact: Midjourney's Pro plan includes 30 fast GPU hours per month, roughly 1,800 images.
Midjourney's Mega plan includes 60 fast GPU hours per month, roughly 3,600 images.
Midjourney's annual billing reduces plan prices by 20%, with Basic at $8, Standard at $24, Pro at $48, and Mega at $96 per month.
facts.quote: Annual billing knocks 20% off all plans

facts.fact: Extra fast GPU time on Midjourney is available on any tier at $4 per hour.
facts.quote: extra fast GPU time is also available on any tier at $4 per hour

facts.fact: Midjourney's Relax mode generation takes 0 to 30 minutes according to Midjourney's own documentation.
facts.quote: Generation takes anywhere from 0 to 30 minutes ([per Midjourney's own docs]

facts.fact: Midjourney's Relax mode is unavailable on the Basic plan and unlimited on Standard, Pro, and Mega plans.
facts.quote: on Standard, Pro, and Mega plans, it's unlimited.

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic and Standard plans each allow 3 concurrent jobs, while Pro and Mega allow 12.
facts.quote: The second is 12 concurrent jobs, up from 3

facts.fact: Midjourney's outputs are capped at 2048px.
facts.quote: Midjourney's outputs are capped at 2048px

facts.fact: Midjourney videos start at 5 seconds and can extend to 21 seconds.
facts.quote: Videos start at 5 seconds and can extend to 21 seconds.

facts.fact: Companies with annual gross revenue over $1 million must be on Pro or Mega plans for any commercial work, according to Midjourney's terms as stated by the author.
facts.quote: companies with annual gross revenue over $1 million must be on Pro or Mega for any commercial work.

facts.fact: Fast mode generates images in 10 to 30 seconds, and a standard image costs roughly one minute of fast GPU time.
facts.quote: It generates images in 10 to 30 seconds and draws directly from your monthly GPU hour allocation.

facts.fact: Upscaling and running variations in Midjourney fast mode can each take 2 to 4 minutes.
facts.quote: Upscaling and running variations can each take 2 to 4 minutes
